original_question: Johnny is picking up the toys on the floor of his room. He'd dumped a lego boxed set with 500 pieces on the floor, and another one that had 3 times more pieces than the 500 piece one, and another one that had 1/4 the number of pieces. How many blocks does Johnny pick up if he picks up all the legos?
